lines.zh: 我挂在湿地的芦苇叶下。
lines.en: I hang beneath a reed leaf in the wetland.
I sway along with the vapour.
The air is damp and my shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 芦苇换个角度，我也换个角度。
lines.en: When the reed turns, so do I.
The wind smells of mud and water.
My silk hook swings under the leaf.
The water's glare makes me shine.
I have no legs; I can only hang.
The reed bends and I slide along.
I change slowly in the damp.

lines.zh: 一只蜻蜓停在旁边，又飞了。
lines.en: A dragonfly rests nearby, then leaves.
I am a little heavier than yesterday.

lines.zh: 水汽在我壳上结了一层。
lines.en: A film of moisture forms on my shell.
I rise and fall with the leaf tip.
This marsh is damp; very suitable.
I have not moved all day.
I hang while something changes inside.
The damp keeps my shell cool.
I hear insects at the water's edge.
The reeds sway in time.
My wings have not formed yet.

lines.zh: 我不需要看，也能感觉到光。
lines.en: I need not see; I can feel the light.
Clouds cross the water slowly.
There is a thin mist on my shell.
I wait for a clear morning.

lines.zh: 有人从水边走过，脚步很轻。
lines.en: Someone passed the water, steps light.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地伸了伸里面的腿。
lines.en: I stretch the legs inside, slowly.

lines.zh: 这片湿地养着很多种蝶。
lines.en: These wetlands raise many kinds of butterfly.
You came through the water.

lines.zh: 别把水花溅到我的壳上。
lines.en: Do not splash my shell.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水里，也在我身上。
lines.en: Your shadow is in the water and on me.
I am on this side of the marsh.
I am not ready to emerge yet.
Come nearer and the reeds will rustle.
Under the reed leaf, I hang steady.
Do you want to watch me change?

lines.zh: 我还动不了，只能看着你。
lines.en: I cannot move yet; I can only watch you.
My shell is dented.
I swung and nearly fell.
Every droplet was shaken off.
I can neither flee nor cry out.
My silk has loosened half a turn.
It is stuffier inside now.
I am curled very tight.
This scar will last until I emerge.
I can do nothing about it.
I wait for it to be over.

lines.zh: 蛹的这段日子我不进食。
lines.en: In these pupa days I do not feed.
Take that away.
There is no mouth to use in here either.
What I want is moisture.

lines.zh: 你把叶子打湿，我会好点。
lines.en: Wet the leaf and I will fare better.
I do not look at it; I look at the light.
Keep it; give it to a caterpillar.
I do not feed these days.
The reed sways and I hit the stalk.
The bump shakes the droplets off.
I spun once; the silk holds.

lines.zh: 水面被你的脚步震得起了纹。
lines.en: Your steps ring ripples across the water.
I cannot dodge; I can only sway.
You touched the leaf, not me.
I press to the leaf and steady.
The damp makes my shell slippery.
I am hanging where I was again.
Do not push me; I would fall in the water.
Not at this stage.
My wings are not grown; I cannot speak of it.
You are asking a chrysalis in a marsh.
I am only responsible for becoming a butterfly.
I hang quietly and say nothing.
My wings will take me to find that.
The damp softens every word.
The wind bends the reeds lower.

lines.zh: 玩家搬不动我，这是规矩。
lines.en: Players cannot move me; that is the rule.
You reach out and I only sway.
Do not pull; the silk will break into the water.
Are you picking this reed leaf?
If I fall in, it is over.

lines.zh: 你把手放低，我就不晃了。
lines.en: Lower your hand and I will stop swaying.
This leaf holds me.
I stay here until I emerge.
No one is taking me away.

lines.zh: 湿气里那点动静我记住了。
lines.en: I mark that stir in the damp air.
Its shadow presses on the water.
I cannot run; I can only curl.
It parts the reeds.
My shell is going cold.
It is only a leaf away.
I hold everything inside still.
It sniffs the water.
It walks along the water's edge.
Its foot sinks into the mud.
I dare not move at all.
It looks up at the reeds.
My shell matches the water's colour.
I hear it breathing.
It reaches and touches the leaf.
The leaf moves and I move with it.
It has gone, and the ripples remain.
Hanging as a pupa, I can do nothing.
It bit my shell once.
A white line is left on the shell.
I curl tighter inside.
I tremble inside the shell.
The reed leaf flicks it away.
My silk swings wildly.
It backs off and goes elsewhere.
I am unhurt, only frightened.

lines.zh: 它扑了空，游到对岸去了。
lines.en: It missed and went to the far bank.

lines.zh: 我在湿地苇叶下结成蛹。
lines.en: I formed as a chrysalis under a reed leaf.
The water lies just below me.
The damp here suits me.
This is the first time I hear frogs.
Droplets still cling to my shell.
The wind comes off the water.
Something has begun to move inside.
The reeds are much taller than I am.
This marsh is very quiet.
I am settled and can wait.
The fire drives all the moisture off.
I drop into the water and sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我从苇叶上掀开。
lines.en: The blast tears me off the reed.
An arrow splits a corner of the shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量顺着潮湿的丝传上来。
lines.en: That force comes up the damp silk.

lines.zh: 这些天不吃东西，我也虚。
lines.en: Fasting these days leaves me weak.
The lightning bleaches the water white.
The leaf and I plunge together.
